title: A gate's host_unchecked reason can be set with backlog.py, and the host word check skips 'host-bound' wording
goal: Found at the SP-d3hybrlv start: ST-pjkmiyqe gate g1 asked who reshapes a story on a host-bound sprint, and start warned that it names a host setup with no --host-check; no backlog.py command sets a gate's host_unchecked reason (only gate add --host-check exists), so the warning could not be answered. backlog.py sets host_unchecked on an existing gate, and the host-word check does not fire on a gate that names no setup.
